lifecycleStages.name: Discovered
lifecycleStages.description: Topic, event, biographical figure, or source identified for future platform inclusion.

lifecycleStages.name: Research Required
lifecycleStages.description: Topic queued for primary source gathering, isnad evaluation, and scholarly references.

lifecycleStages.name: Draft in Progress
lifecycleStages.description: Content being authored with structured headings, transliterations, and citation links.

lifecycleStages.name: Source & Provenance Review
lifecycleStages.description: Verification that all claims, Hadith numbers, and dates match authentic editions.

lifecycleStages.name: Linguistic & Transliteration Review
lifecycleStages.description: Arabic diacritics, Urdu typography, ALA-LC transliteration, and English readability check.

lifecycleStages.name: Scholarly Review Required
lifecycleStages.description: Mandatory human review by qualified Islamic scholar for theological and juristic claims.

lifecycleStages.name: Approved for Publication
lifecycleStages.description: Human review successfully signed off with documented provenance and license clearance.

lifecycleStages.name: Live in Production
lifecycleStages.description: Content actively served on website, bundled in PWA, and accessible to end-users.

lifecycleStages.name: Needs Revision
lifecycleStages.description: Defect, typo, citation omission, or correction flag raised requiring editorial remedy.

lifecycleStages.name: Archived
lifecycleStages.description: Superseded or retired content preserved for historical version tracking.

contentRiskTiers.name: Scriptural & Divine Text
contentRiskTiers.notes: Zero modification of Quranic Arabic allowed. Automated translation strictly forbidden; peer-reviewed printed translations only.

contentRiskTiers.name: Prophetic Sunnah & Fiqh Rulings
contentRiskTiers.notes: Every Hadith must trace to canonical collections with authenticated grading. Madhhab differences must be noted.

contentRiskTiers.name: Biographical & Historical Narratives
contentRiskTiers.notes: Narratives must cite classical works (Ibn Hisham, Ibn Sa'd, Tabari). Weak or contested stories must be labeled.

contentRiskTiers.name: Technical Utilities & UI Labels
contentRiskTiers.notes: Mathematical algorithms, UI button strings, and privacy policy legal disclosures.

editorialRoles.description: Identifies primary classical sources, page references, and historical event chronologies.
Validates JSON schemas, HTML semantics, SEO meta tags, and internal link integrity.
Validates Arabic diacritics, Urdu Nastaliq styling, and English educational clarity.
Formally credentialed scholar verifying theological orthodoxy, Hadith gradings, and Fiqh accuracy.
